profile.constituencyprofile_Text: Peddapuram Constituency consists of 2 mandals i.e., Peddapuram and Samalkota and 2 Municipalities i.e., Peddapuram Municipality and Samalkota Municipality which are located in Kakinada district and its head quarter is Peddapuram. Peddapuram revenue division is an administrative division in the Kakinada district. The Constituency is strategically located, connecting major urban centers like Kakinada, just 22 km away, Rajahmundry, 40 km away and Visakhapatnam 158 km away. Spanning an area of 291.46 sq. km, Peddapuram offers significant potential in agriculture, aquaculture and eco-tourism.Peddapuram geography is characterized by fertile alluvial soils and a network of rivers and canals, including the Yeleru canal, which is a lifeline for irrigation. The Constituency has 57% of its land under agriculture and horticulture, primarily cultivating Paddy, Oil palm and Tapioca. Peddapuram Constituency, located in Kakinada district, comprises two mandals (Peddapuram and Samalkota) and two municipalities. Strategically positioned near Kakinada (22 km), Rajahmundry (40 km), and Visakhapatnam (158 km), it boasts fertile agricultural lands, abundant water resources, and cultural heritage. economy_text.economy_Text:
Peddapuram’s Economy at a Glance


The Economic Vision Plan for Peddapuram lays a structured path for accelerating economic growth, boosting employment, and ensuring inclusive development. With a Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) of ₹7,835 crores in 2023-24, Peddapuram is projected to expand steadily, reaching ₹16,376 crores by 2028-29, marking a significant transformation across agriculture, industry, and services sectors. The Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) reached ₹7,835Crores and the total GVA of the Constituency is 7,248cr. Agriculture & Allied Sector contribution is 2,101cr. with a share of 28.99%. The industry sector contribution is 2,593 cr. with share of 35.78%. The services sector contribution is 2554cr. with share of 35.23%. The per capita income of the Constituency is Rs.2,48,259.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Peddapuram is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like Real estate, Ownership of Dwellings, manufacturing, livestock and  agriculture. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant urban and economic hub by 2047.
